scripts.format: vp fmt apps packages tooling vite.config.ts && biome format --write && prettier --write "apps/site/src/**/*.astro" && bun run --silent py ruff format apps/tts
scripts.check-format: vp fmt apps packages tooling vite.config.ts --check && biome format && prettier --check "apps/site/src/**/*.astro" && bun run --silent py ruff format --check apps/tts
scripts.lint: astro sync --root apps/site && vp lint apps packages tooling vite.config.ts && biome lint --error-on-warnings && bun run lint:py
scripts.lint:py: bun run --silent py ruff check apps/tts
scripts.lint:fix: astro sync --root apps/site && vp lint apps packages tooling vite.config.ts --fix && biome lint --write && bun run lint:py --fix
scripts.check:src: astro sync --root apps/site && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/site --noEmit --runExternalCode && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
